title: Garden Club Open House (article example)
taskText: You are a member of your school's Garden Club and you saw this notice about the Garden Club Open House. Write an article for the school newsletter to encourage your schoolmates to come. Use the notice for details, and include one idea of your own on how pupils can keep their seedlings healthy at home.

modelLetter:
Come and Grow with Us at the Garden Club Open House!
By Wei Ming Tan

Have you ever wondered how the herbs and vegetables on your plate begin their journey? I am excited to share the details of our Garden Club Open House and to invite every one of you to take part. As a proud member of the Garden Club, I have spent many afternoons preparing the Rooftop Garden for this special event.

The Open House will be held on Wednesday, 18 March, from 2pm to 4pm. Furthermore, it will take place at the Rooftop Garden on Level 5. Visitors can plant their very own seedling and taste fresh herbs picked from our garden. Moreover, please remember to bring a recycled pot or container so that you can take your seedling home. To take part, simply register with Ms Lim in the Staff Room by 11 March. After taking your seedling home, you can set a daily phone reminder to water it so that it grows tall and strong.

So why not join us at the Rooftop Garden and register with Ms Lim today? Thank you for reading, and I hope to see you there!
